product.name: Direct Print
product.description: An on-demand 3D printing service for prototyping and small production runs up to 100 plastic parts with instant quoting and order tracking.

product.name: Volume Print
product.description: A 3D printing service for medium to large production runs up to 10,000 parts with custom print settings and project management support.

product.name: 3D Design Services
product.description: Professional CAD design services to create manufacturable 3D models from sketches or engineering drawings for 3D printing.

product.name: 3D Printing Materials
product.description: A selection of plastic materials including PLA, PET-G, TPU, and rigid TPU for various strength, flexibility, and durability needs in 3D printed parts.
